item.title: WATCH- ‘His choice to play ODIs disappoints me’- Manjrekar says Virat Kohli quit Tests instead of working on his flaws
item.description: Former India cricketer Sanjay Manjrekar has criticized Virat Kohli’s decision to quit Test cricket but continue to play in ODIs, which he considers the easy format. Virat Kohli, along with Root, Steve Smith, and Kane Williamson, formed the 'Fab 4' for the longest format. However, Kohli is the only one of the quartet who has retired from Test cricket. item.title: WATCH- Jemimah Rodrigues' captivating rendition of ‘Aashayein’ song mesmerizes audience at Reliance event
item.description: India women’s star Jemimah Rodrigues astonished fans with a rocking musical moment at the recent Reliance Foundation United in Triumph event in Mumbai, when she mesmerized the crowd with her performance of the uplifting anthem Aashayein, which is from the acclaimed 2005 sports movie Iqbal. Iqbal depicts the tale of Shreyas Talpade, a deaf and mute youngster who overcomes enormous hurdles to follow his ambition of playing cricket for India, with the help of his coach, played by Naseeruddin Shah.

item.title: “Should definitely do it”- Harbhajan Singh says nothing wrong in split coaching for Indian team despite Gautam Gambhir’s opposition
item.description: Ex-India spinner Harbhajan Singh supports the notion of India having separate coaches for different formats in the future. While Gautam Gambhir, India's head coach since July 2024, has responded angrily to the suggestion, Harbhajan believes there is "nothing wrong" with having different coaches for the red-ball and white-ball formats, given how the Indian team has performed over the past 17 months. item.title: ICC turns down Bangladesh's request to shift their T20 World Cup 2026 matches from India: Report
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) has turned down the Bangladesh Cricket Board’s (BCB) request to relocate their T20 World Cup 2026 fixtures from India to Sri Lanka, ESPNcricinfo reported. According to the report, a virtual call took place between the ICC and BCB on Tuesday (January 6), during which the apex body categorically rejected the latter’s plea to shift Bangladesh’s matches outside India due to security concerns. item.title: “Left out solely because of…”: Harbhajan Singh weighs in on Shubman Gill’s T20 World Cup 2026 snub
item.description: Shubman Gill was the notable omission from India’s T20 World Cup 2026 squad announced last month. He looked to be a sure-shot for the marquee event after his return to the format and being given vice-captaincy and the opener's role.
